title: The Wanderlane Traveller Club Qualifying Schedule
content:
This schedule states, for each tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club, the qualifying figures against which a member's record is measured. The entry threshold is the number of tier-qualifying points needed in one qualifying period to enter the tier. The retention threshold is the number needed in one qualifying period to hold the tier again. The journey alternative is the number of booked journeys that qualifies for the tier instead of the points route. The qualifying period is stated in calendar months, and the review month is the month of the year in which the annual tier review falls, numbered from 1 to 12. The grace months are the calendar months of grace after a failed review before the tier actually drops, and soft landing records whether a failed review drops the member only one tier rather than to the level actually earned.

## The schedule

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Entry threshold (qualifying points) | 0 | 12500 | 30000 | 60000 | 110000 | 200000 |
| Retention threshold (qualifying points) | 0 | 10000 | 25000 | 50000 | 95000 | 175000 |
| Journey alternative (booked journeys) | 0 | 8 | 18 | 32 | 55 | 90 |
| Qualifying period (calendar months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Review month | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Grace after a failed review (calendar months) | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 6 |
| Soft landing | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Notes on the figures

The qualifying period runs for 12 calendar months at every tier, and the annual review falls in month 1 at every tier.

At Wanderlane Blue the entry threshold, the retention threshold, the journey alternative and the grace months all stand at 0, and soft landing is not carried. At every tier above Wanderlane Blue the retention threshold is the lower of the two thresholds: 10000 against an entry threshold of 12500 at Wanderlane Silver, 25000 against 30000 at Wanderlane Gold, 50000 against 60000 at Wanderlane Platinum, 95000 against 110000 at Wanderlane Titanium, and 175000 against 200000 at Wanderlane Ambassador.

Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Platinum both carry 3 grace months; the figure otherwise rises with the tier, from 1 at Wanderlane Silver and 2 at Wanderlane Gold to 6 at Wanderlane Ambassador. Soft landing is carried at Wanderlane Gold and above.
